intro-hello.text: Hi, I'm Koko! Let me walk you through a game.

intro-what.text: Kokonad: live guessing games for community events. The pot is split on Monad by a contract, not by the host.
intro-what.say: Koko-nad: live guessing games for community events. The pot is split on Monad by a contract, not by the host.

host-fund.text: A host starts a room and funds it with coins. Everyone else plays for free.

host-seal.text: The host writes the questions, and they are sealed on Monad before anyone joins.

join-scan.text: Players scan the code on the big screen. Nothing to install.

join-free.text: No wallet, no gas. Type a name, and your coins from the host are already waiting.

question-open.text: A question opens. One coin from each player drops into the pot.

question-seal.text: Pick, then lock. Your answer is sealed: nobody can peek or copy it, not even the host.

question-clock.text: When the clock runs out, no more answers get in.

reveal-open.text: Time's up. Every phone opens its sealed answer on its own.

reveal-host.text: The host sets what really happened. That is the one thing a person decides.

result-split.text: The contract splits the pot between everyone who was right. Eka takes all 3 coins.
result-split.say: The contract splits the pot between everyone who was right. Ekka takes all 3 coins.

result-lost.text: Wrong, or sat it out? Your coin stays in the pot.

split-in.text: Say six people play. Six coins go into the pot.

split-out.text: Three were right, so each takes two. Wrong, or sat out: nothing.

payout-wait.text: The contract waits 60 seconds before it pays: its window for disputes.

payout-land.text: Then the coins land. No one has to claim anything.

payout-standings.text: And the standings update for the whole room.

monad-tx.text: That payout? A real transaction on Monad: 3 coins from the room to Eka.
monad-tx.say: That payout? A real transaction on Monad: 3 coins from the room to Ekka.

monad-count.text: Every seal, reveal and payout is on-chain. This game was 23 transactions.

monad-gas.text: Players never pay gas. They sign, a relayer sends, and Monad's fast blocks keep the room in sync.

outro-try.text: Open a room and try it. See you at your next meetup!

pitch-hello.text: Hi, I'm Koko. Here is who built Kokonad, and why.
pitch-hello.say: Hi, I'm Koko. Here is who built Koko-nad, and why.

pitch-team.text: One person built it: a solo builder from DevWeb3Jogja, a web3 community in Yogyakarta, Indonesia.
pitch-team.say: One person built it: a solo builder from Dev Web Three Jogja, a web three community in Yogyakarta, Indonesia.

pitch-problem-1.text: Every community event runs a quick game to wake the room up. The prize is the awkward part.

pitch-problem-2.text: Someone checks the answers by hand. Someone holds the money. And someone forgets to pay.

pitch-problem-3.text: And a quiz only asks what somebody already knows.

pitch-solution-1.text: So Kokonad lets the room guess what happens next, and puts the pot in a contract on Monad.
pitch-solution-1.say: So Koko-nad lets the room guess what happens next, and puts the pot in a contract on Monad.

pitch-solution-2.text: Answers stay sealed until time is up. Then the contract pays everyone who was right.

pitch-monad-1.text: Why Monad? A game is dozens of tiny transactions. Our recorded game was 23 of them, for less than one MON in total.
pitch-monad-1.say: Why Monad? A game is dozens of tiny transactions. Our recorded game was 23 of them, for less than one mon in total.

pitch-monad-2.text: Anywhere slower or pricier, the fees would be bigger than the prizes.

pitch-users-1.text: The first users are people who run small community events, starting with the builder's own community.

pitch-users-2.text: A session needs only a link and a shared screen. And every player who scans the code sees how to host the next one.

pitch-status.text: Kokonad is live on Monad testnet today. So far the players were test browsers. The first rooms with real people come next.
pitch-status.say: Koko-nad is live on Monad testnet today. So far the players were test browsers. The first rooms with real people come next.

pitch-outro.text: Open a room and try it!
